hypothesis: hypothesis.md: medium trend persistence, trend pullback resumption, equilibrium reversion
entry_timeframe: daily source calendar; Sunday merged Monday; no interpolation
entry_rules: hypothesis.md; next observed open, confirmed daily signals

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: 3 for pullback; dynamic for other families per user reset
exit_rules.boundary: last observed close force liquidation primary; excluded sensitivity

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously viewed by other project research, not untouched OOS. This rule uses training only for selection.

cost_and_fill_model.carry_day_count: ceil((exit exposure timestamp-entry raw first)/86400); intraday exits use daily raw last+60
cost_and_fill_model.fills: hypothesis.md: stop gap open then queued open exit then daily stop first, favorable target gap capped

position_sizing_and_currency: one position per symbol; equal initial price R, no account return or compounding

acceptance_gates.selection: one passing training candidate: highest worst-cost PF, highest worst-cost mean R, lowest worst-cost MTM DD, id alphabetical; no fallback
acceptance_gates.failure_stop: no next-period evaluation after rejection; no additional search
acceptance_gates.carry_stress_1pip: separate robustness flag; nonpositive prohibits live-ready claim

cross_symbol_rule: all 15 common rules and equal R; no posthoc symbol selection
code_identifier: scripts/research_daily_edge_reset.py; code and source hashes recorded before result generation
frozen_at: 2026-09-10 before current-rule result inspection; exact UTC recorded in code_input_hashes.json
